probability_model_policy.rule: Weeks 1-3 outcomes update evaluation, execution controls and optimizer stress behavior, but do not change frozen V2 probability coefficients before Week 4.

week3_v2.interpretation: Positive one-week evidence only; insufficient for promotion, confidence inflation, coefficient changes or stake escalation.

external_sources.weeks1_2_note: No canonical exact-line prospective external-source ledger is available for Weeks 1-2; do not retrospectively manufacture one from final outcomes.

week1.accounting_note: Amanda's replay ledger and commissioner ending balance differ by $500; use commissioner balance as pool state and do not use the discrepancy to infer strategy performance.

week2.accounting_note: Amanda's replay ledger and commissioner ending balance differ by $100; use commissioner balance as pool state.

adaptive_interpretation: Historical deployment and overlap are diagnostics, not fixed Week 4 targets.
Do not infer that more or less overlap is universally better from three weeks.
Require the optimizer to report overlap concentration and compare materially different overlap structures when expected value is close.
Do not increase Week 4 deployment merely because the final Week 3 V2 slate performed well.

classes.CROSS_SOURCE_CONFIRMED: At least two preserved current-market sources imply value on the same Sly side and none imply the opposite side.
classes.SOURCE_SENSITIVE: One preserved source implies Sly value while another is market-equal; retain the side as a candidate but stress its edge to zero.
classes.SOURCE_DISPUTED: Preserved current sources imply different preferred Sly sides; do not treat as an authoritative edge until later market refresh resolves or the portfolio deliberately overrides with explicit rationale.
classes.MARKET_EQUAL: Preserved current sources are effectively equal to Sly; frozen model residual direction near 50% is not promoted into a betting edge.

market_edge_policy.rule: Never average conflicting live lines into a synthetic edge solely to make a game actionable.

decision_reconciliation_policy.authoritative_baseline: latest timestamped model snapshot available before submission
decision_reconciliation_policy.week3_learning: Earlier CAR/SEA context remained influential after the final model changed sides; Week 4 must make divergence visible before wagers are finalized.

optimizer_adaptation.primary_objective_unchanged: maximize expected household prize value under actual Monopoly rules
additional_week4_stress_tests: Set every SOURCE_SENSITIVE price edge to zero while retaining market-equal probabilities.
Evaluate SOURCE_DISPUTED games under each preserved source separately rather than averaging them.
Compare portfolio utility with and without high household overlap when alternatives are near-tied.
Report current-week downside/CVaR retention and future-minimum failure risk for each finalist portfolio.
sizing_rules: No arbitrary fixed bankroll percentage becomes the Week 4 policy from Weeks 1-3 history.
No stake escalation from Week 3 hit rate alone.
Supporting/no-edge games may remain at minimum wager when required by contest constraints; incremental dollars require a defensible edge that survives stress testing.
Catherine and Amanda are optimized jointly but retain entry-specific bets and risk diagnostics.

legacy_heuristic_policy.rule: Do not invent Week 4 V1/M1-M5 numerical outputs from hard-coded Week 3 UI grades. Preserve them as legacy comparators only until their formulas/data contracts are recovered or explicitly redesigned.

step4_guardrails: Standings and bankroll affect portfolio optimization only, never NFL cover probabilities.
External sources remain context/benchmark evidence with zero hard-coded prediction weight.
Weather and injuries remain separate contextual layers until validated incrementally; Step 5 will refresh them.
Week 3 outcome evidence may improve process controls without contaminating Week 4 prediction probabilities.
All source disagreement and accounting discrepancies remain visible rather than silently reconciled.
